FIELD INCIDENT REPORT
Form FIR-1 (rev. 2026-03)
OPERATOR
Northline Gas Transmission Ltd.
REPORTED BY
Field operator
RECEIVED VIA
Phone call (on-call write-up)
DESCRIPTION OF THE EVENT (what happened, when, where, who, what was released)
I got a call from the field operator at Northline Gas Transmission Ltd. about an issue near
Thunder Bay, Ontario. They said on Aug 23 at 14:00, they found a natural gas release. The gas
released is sweet natural gas. The volume released was metered at 2.0 m³ and the release rate
was estimated at about 0.1 kg/s. The operator said it was due to frost heave, a geotechnical
failure. Everything stayed inside the station fence. No other details were given. The field operator
is still on site.
J. Smith, On-call Operator
SUPERVISOR REVIEW
